name: Peapods Finance
rootCause: On December 13th, Peapods Finance was hacked by white hat hackers due to a reentrancy vulnerability. On December 14th, Peapods Finance tweeted that the hackers returned 90% of the funds. On December 15th, the hacker, @0xaxxe, tweeted that he returned the white hat fee to the team.

descriptions.text: On December 13th, Peapods Finance was hacked by white hat hackers due to a reentrancy vulnerability. On December 14th, Peapods Finance tweeted that the hackers returned 90% of the funds. On December 15th, the hacker, @0xaxxe, tweeted that he returned the white hat fee to the team.

On December 13, 2023, Peapods Finance's WeightedIndex contract was exploited on Ethereum via a reentrancy vulnerability, resulting in a temporary loss of approximately $231,192. The attacker, later revealed as a white hat, drained funds via a malicious contract and returned 100% of the funds in two transactions. The WeightedIndex contract was vulnerable to a reentrancy attack, allowing an attacker to repeatedly call a state-modifying function before previous operations finished updating balances, enabling the draining of PEAS tokens.
